decls.name: Streams
decls.doc: Streams exercises the stream type mappings from tmp/06-codegen-spec.md 3.1.1: a WritableStream property/return maps to io.WriteCloser, a ReadableStream property/return maps to io.ReadCloser (unchanged from before 3.1.1), a ReadableStream parameter maps to io.Reader (via jsrt.ReadableStreamFromReader), a WritableStream parameter falls back to js.Value for now, and a types: override can force io.Reader on an otherwise-unresolvable union parameter.

members.name: download
members.doc: returns a ReadableStream; property/return position is unaffected by the parameter-position change

members.name: upload
members.doc: a ReadableStream parameter maps to io.Reader

members.name: attach
members.doc: a WritableStream parameter falls back to js.Value for now

members.name: uploadRaw
members.doc: an otherwise-unresolvable union parameter forced to io.Reader via a types: override

members.name: uploadBuffered
members.doc: io.ReaderAsArrayBuffer keeps the Go parameter as io.Reader and reads it into an ArrayBuffer
